surface_value: Central tolerance defects are important and probably essential contributors to spontaneous autoimmune disease. T cells with high affinity for self-antigen escape thymic deletion due to defects in the normal process of either positive or negative selection, leading to a higher proportion of self-reactive T cells in the peripheral repertoire.
